name: trassd-tinymce
description: Skills and agents that enforce TinyMCE best practices: initializing the editor (tinymce.init / EditorManager), configuring it (toolbar, menubar, plugins, content styling and the typed option system), working with the Editor instance API (content get/set, commands, events, undo, formatting), enabling the bundled plugins, authoring custom plugins that register UI via the editor's UI registry, and controlling content filtering & HTML sanitization (schema, valid_elements, XSS-protection options).
